author: The Current
description:
Legendary songwriter and producer Linda Perry sat down with host Jill Riley and shared the process of writing the song "Beautiful," famously interpreted by Christina Aguilera in 2002. Perry sang the song herself for her album 'Let It Die Here' released in early 2026.

Read and listen to the complete interview now at thecurrent.org

title: Linda Perry on the song "Beautiful" #LindaPerry
